name: dyoe-trust-mcp

tools.name: dyoe_verify
tools.description: Check whether a website, business, or wallet is a scam before an agent trusts or pays it — fraud, phishing and rug-risk screening. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), trust_score, domain age, red_flags. Input: ?target=domain Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

target.description: Domain or URL to trust-check (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_transaction
tools.description: Vet an entire payment before an agent sends money: is the counterparty site legit, is the payee wallet sanctioned or disposable, is the amount within policy. Returns proceed/caution/stop, reasons, and a signed attestation — one go/no-go instead of three calls. Input: ?domain=merchant.com&wallet=0x...&amount=500 Price: $0.10 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_wallet
tools.description: Screen a crypto wallet address before an agent sends funds to it: OFAC sanctions check, on-chain footprint (empty or disposable address), human-vouch overlay. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), sanctioned flag, on-chain activity, red_flags. Input: ?address=0x... Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_approve
tools.description: Approve or deny an agent action instantly against a human-set policy — no waiting. Returns a signed decision receipt; anything over the policy line escalates to a human. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required) Price: $0.02 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

action.description: What the agent wants to do (e.g. pay invoice)

counterparty.description: Domain or wallet on the other side (required) (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_review
tools.description: Get a named human to review an agent action against a checklist and sign off on it. Poll /api/task?id=<id> for the signed receipt. Priced on the amount at stake. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required) Price: $15.00 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

action.description: What a named human should review and sign off on (e.g. approve vendor contract)

counterparty.description: Domain or wallet on the other side (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_contacts
tools.description: Extract public business emails, phone numbers, and social profiles from a website. Batch-safe contact enrichment for autonomous agents. Input: website URL. Returns structured JSON. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: Site to pull emails/phones/socials from (e.g. https://stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_intel
tools.description: Research a company or website in one call: what they do, legitimacy verdict, domain age, how to reach them, social presence, scam red flags — background checks for agents. Sources disclosed, not a black box: RDAP registry domain age, HTTPS reachability, on-page contact signals, DYOE human-vouch registry. Input: ?target=domain Price: $0.10 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

target.description: Company or website for a deep dossier (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_merchant
tools.description: Is this online store safe to buy from? Scam/fraud check + trust verdict (safe/caution/avoid) + store signals (checkout, returns, payment methods) — counterparty trust for shopping & commerce agents before they pay. Input: ?url= Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: Store URL to check before buying (e.g. https://shopify.com)

tools.name: dyoe_audit
tools.description: Score any website 0-100 for legitimacy, trust, SEO and contactability — due diligence on a company in one call. Returns a verdict plus prioritized fixes. Input: ?url=domain Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_reputation
tools.description: Look up the track record of any domain or wallet: how many times it has been assessed, verdict history, times flagged, first and last seen, a reputation score and a signed credential — a credit score for counterparties. Computed only from DYOE's own logged prior assessments; thin history is labeled as such. Input: ?target= Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

target.description: Domain or wallet to look up history for (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_credential_org
tools.description: Issue a signed, independently verifiable credential that a business domain passed a trust check — returns verdict, trust_score and domain_age. Input: ?domain= Price: $0.10 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

domain.description: Business domain to issue a credential for (e.g. stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_token
tools.description: Look up a token's price and market data plus a scam and rug-risk read on the project behind the coin — market data and counterparty trust in one call. Input: ?symbol= Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_extract
tools.description: Extract clean main text content from any web page (no nav/ads) — for research & summarizing agents. Input: ?url= Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: Page to extract clean text from (e.g. https://stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_metadata
tools.description: Extract title, description, OpenGraph image, favicon & canonical from any URL — link previews & summaries. Input: ?url= Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

url.description: Page to read title/description/OG image from (e.g. https://stripe.com)

tools.name: dyoe_crypto
tools.description: Live crypto price + 24h change, market cap & volume for any coin — for trading agents. Input: ?symbol=btc Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_market
tools.description: Global crypto market overview — total market cap, 24h change, BTC/ETH dominance. Input: (none) Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_trending
tools.description: The coins trending right now — for trading & research agents. Input: (none) Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_movers
tools.description: Top gainers & losers (24h) across the top 100 coins — for trading agents. Input: (none) Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_fx
tools.description: Currency conversion + live exchange rate (ECB data). Input: ?from=USD&to=EUR&amount=100 Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_weather
tools.description: Current conditions + 3-day forecast for any city — for travel & planning agents. Input: ?city=Atlanta Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_wiki
tools.description: Factual summary of any topic from Wikipedia — for research agents. Input: ?topic=Bitcoin Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

tools.name: dyoe_destination
tools.description: Get what a trip-planning agent needs before it books, in one call: weather and 3-day forecast, local currency with live FX from USD, and a scam check on the booking site before it pays. Input: ?city=Athens&date=2026-11-20&currency=EUR&booking=hotel-site.com&budget=1500 Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

booking.description: Booking site domain to safety-check (e.g. booking.com)
